function.description: Claim winnings from a RESOLVED (settled) prediction position — the market has an outcome and this position won. Use solana.predict.sell instead to exit an OPEN position before resolution. Broadcasts and returns truthful-pending; estimatedPayoutUsd in the output is an order-preview ESTIMATE, not executed truth. Payouts settle in JupUSD (6 decimals), not USDC, and they arrive in a LATER keeper transaction — this call's broadcast does not deliver them, so the position stays pending until settlement is observed. To convert a payout to USDC, run solana.swap.quote/solana.swap.execute with tokenIn JupUSD, tokenOut USDC once the balance appears.
function.name: solana__predict_claim
